correctness.rationale: The graph-distance classification is exhaustive for every pair category; it gives a literal flag simplicial join at radius three. The two full layer simplices are disjoint contractible CW subcomplexes, so their quotient is the rank-(m-1) two-vertex multi-edge graph; join Kunneth then gives the exact integral wedge of (m-1)^2 three-spheres. Girth eight meets the published radius-two collapse bound (3*2+1=7). Arm-pole automorphism structure, bridge coefficient lattices, two cancelling pole-swap signs, and the primitive invariant matrix are proved over the integers. A standalone dependency-free checker exhaustively checks distances, faces, mod-two ranks and sample traces for 2<=m<=7/5; finite results only corroborate the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The all-parameter integral homotopy filtration of a canonical branching graph family shows a genuinely quadratic rank jump in third homology at radius three, where the predecessor length-three family has only linear second homology. The complete integral tensor-square representation, invariant primitive class and rational quotient homology identify symmetry information not implied by Betti numbers. The graph family and scale arise naturally from the girth-stability threshold and overlapping cycles, not an arbitrary computed slice.
